description: Leartech preset for Go services. Layer on top of default.json — adds groups for the leartech-go-runtime base image and internal Go libraries.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge leartech-go-runtime image bumps as soon as they land. 'at any time' overrides default Monday-only schedule — internal lib, low risk, but consumers can be blocked on it (e.g. fleet Go-1.26 bump 2026-05-07).
Auto-merge leartech-go-common + generated leartech-go-packages/* as soon as they land. 'at any time' overrides default Monday-only schedule because internal libs may need to flow within hours.

Flow go.mod `toolchain` bumps fast and on their own. Renovate already proposes toolchain updates by default (gomod depType=toolchain), but the base preset's Monday-only patch/minor grouping buried them — a stdlib advisory fixed only by a toolchain patch (e.g. GO-2026-6809 → go1.27.3) then waited a week or became a hand-edit per repo. The catalog Go tasks run GOTOOLCHAIN=auto, so bumping this directive is what moves the build/test/scan toolchain. Scoped to toolchain only; the `go` (source-compat floor) is left alone per Renovate's own guidance.
